title: Re-express the 87 host assertions S3 dropped, and split memory_classes

ledger.rewritten_note: Negative rewrite credit: this slice ADDS lines on purpose. S3 removed 4,284 lines of test bodies living inside src/ via include!; this puts back ~1,600 of public-API black-box suite that exercises the same contracts from outside. The trade is worth making and it is still an addition, recorded as one.

gates.files_over_1500: 27 -> 26, back to the campaign start value

constitution_gaps_found.significance: Classifying all 87 assertions against the constitution turned up ten contracts the constitution did not name, four of them security outcomes: the approval gate on destructive shell (held is not done), the durable tool-policy ledger, write-lease revocation on session fork and rewind, and trust-before-config on an untrusted workspace. Under-recording those would have licensed deleting the code that provides them.
